description: Navigate to the Analog Electricity activity in GCompris (look for Science/Discovery > Electricity/Experiment icons). Once inside, build a simple series circuit using a Battery, a Light Bulb, and connecting Wires. Connect them in a loop so the Light Bulb lights up (glows). Finally, take a screenshot of the working circuit and save it to '/home/ga/circuit_complete.png' (you can use the 'scrot' command from a terminal).
